endpoints.basis: Initial score-pitch search windows from cached recording analysis; final onset positions and worst-region overlays must be inspected before publication.

provenance: EXT: Unchanged named sounding voices from Liu's Leichte Stücke (1900) source are extracted separately; these are written voice identities, not recovered recorded hands. MEAS: 250 canonical voice events contain the same 222 distinct pitch/onset pairs as the legacy MIDI, plus 28 coincident source-voice unisons. Two untied D3 bass quarters at q11/q15 (bars 6/8, beat 2; bassvoices source lines 187/189) are restored from legacy 0.75Q to the written 1Q; separate oboes D3 sixteenths at q11.75/q15.75 remain independent. No source pitches, attacks or written rests are removed. INFERENCE: Recording edition and articulation remain provisional; MIDI duration is not evidence of recording equivalence.
